title: calanthe lyroglossa var. forsythiiflora
intro: Calanthe lyroglossa var. forsythiiflora, commonly known as the Forysthii-flowered calanthe orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calanthe lyroglossa var. forsythiiflora include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation and its potential to modulate the immune system, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
